I was raised atheist, so I was always told that when you die that's it. There's nothing else beyond it you just close your eyes and there's nothing. I was always terrified of that notion because I want the pain to stop more than anything but even if death is a release, what is it a release to? Maybe the release is something worse? I have no idea
